observations: The first pour fills the cup from approximately 0.6 to 4.7 seconds and leaves a visibly dark full cup.
Near 6.8 to 7.2 seconds the cup resets from full to almost empty while the pitcher position also resets, followed by a second pour.
The reset cannot be produced by the visible continuous action and therefore indicates an embedded edit, retake splice, or restarted state inside the downloaded stock file.
decision: Do not use this file as proof payload. Its internal state reset would falsely credit the source editor's pre-existing decision to the Haku Operator.
